axial_source.sign_convention: PDG lists lambda=-1.2753. Compare its magnitude with the positive native Pauli-current reduced coefficient.
axial_source.role: Fourth empirical calibration input selecting U and the native baryon state.

inherited_mass_input_ancestry.uncertainty_scope: Central values only. Hadron targets calibrate three action coefficients and are not independent predictions. Comparison values neither fix those coefficients nor establish a physical species dictionary.

ancestry: The axial datum selects the native split-site state through U. It is a calibration input, not a held-out prediction. No effective current factor is fitted.
colour_edge_choice: Positive native edge-colour Casimir with coefficient1; an explicit architecture control of disconnected-copy coloured thresholds. It is identically zero on every two-cell global singlet, including spatially separated q+diquark states, and supplies no two-cell spatial binding or continuum confinement proof.
